works.title: Cementitious Waterproofing
works.description: Mapped example showing how practical site readiness, method, inspection and open-standard mappings attach to one reusable work identity.

Labor: Contractor-provided labour requirement is kept separate from tools and materials.
Preconditions: Access, weather, water and power readiness checked

wms.title: Authority & scope check
wms.note: Confirm approved drawing/specification/product system and project-specific method before work.

wms.title: Substrate readiness
wms.note: Inspect and prepare substrate; record defects before proceeding.

wms.title: Repairs & interfaces
wms.note: Treat joints, cracks, corners, penetrations and drains only to approved detail.

wms.title: Application sequence
wms.note: Follow approved project/manufacturer method; no demo thickness, mix ratio or curing time is invented.

wms.title: Protection & records
wms.note: Protect accepted work and link evidence to the real execution identity.

works.wms_notice: Illustrative workflow only. Numerical requirements must come from verified project specifications, manufacturer requirements and applicable authoritative standards.

itp.criteria: Approved references, substrate and interfaces verified.
Work follows approved system; deviations are recorded.
Required inspection/test passes and real evidence is linked.

works.title: Construction of Soak Pit
works.description: Fail-closed research example. Identity and numerical technical requirements stay unresolved until live catalogue/design/codal authority is verified.

Labor: Crew requirement pending approved execution plan.
Equipment: Excavation/dewatering/access equipment only if verified site conditions require it
Materials: Stone/aggregate/masonry/pipe/cover/filter materials only after design/specification verification

wms.title: Resolve work identity
wms.note: Check governed work catalogue/BOQ before creating a new work_id.

wms.title: Verify design basis
wms.note: Resolve hydraulic basis, site suitability and governing authority.

wms.title: Clause-level research
wms.note: Trace every numerical requirement to source, edition, clause/table/figure and applicability.

wms.title: Develop construction sequence
wms.note: Only then define setting out, excavation, base/walls/inlet/cover/backfill/inspection/as-built steps.

wms.title: Engineering review of local practice
wms.note: The user-supplied two-rebar alternative remains unapproved until structural/durability/detail checks are complete.

works.wms_notice: No soak-pit dimension, mortar ratio, weep-hole spacing, reinforcement size or separation distance is asserted by this demo.

itp.criteria: Applicable design and authority requirements resolved.
Actual soil, groundwater, utility and safe-excavation conditions recorded.
Real inspection, photos/as-built and acceptance captured.
